title: Design System: การบ้านหลังนวด

display.purpose: The home greeting only (consent title at 34px).

headline.purpose: Posture name, pain question, success headline, 1669 button.

action.purpose: Labels on the largest primary buttons, display face.

answer.purpose: Yes/no labels, repetition counter, steps heading.

question.purpose: The symptom question, set as the screen h1.

body-lg.purpose: Flag messages, card values, emphasised notices.

label.purpose: Date line, brand name, metadata, dt labels, day names.

caption.purpose: Clinic name, plan chip, credits, AI-voice note. The patient floor.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards, lists, chips, unselected answer tiles, notices, flag messages.

shadows.name: button-drop
shadows.purpose: Primary and 1669 buttons, selected answers and pain number, done-day tiles, success disc.

shadows.name: stop-bar
shadows.purpose: The fixed bottom stop bar only, cast upward.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 600ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1); translateY(16px) and opacity 0 to rest; delay calc(var(--i) * 70ms)
motion.purpose: Sections and cards arrive once, staggered.

motion.name: grow-in
motion.value: 800ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.2, 0.4, 1); scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) from the left
motion.purpose: Progress fills on the week bar and done session threads.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms, delays 0, under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

background.name: garden-glow
background.value: radial-gradient(900px 520px at 92% -10%, rgb(242 193 78 / 0.18), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(900px 640px at -12% 18%, rgb(156 181 154 / 0.22), transparent 60%) over #f4f6f0; background-attachment: fixed
background.purpose: Page ground: sun glow top-right, sage glow left.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.value: 576px max-width, centred, 20px side padding at every width

extensions.scope: Recorded from the patient flow /p/[code], modelled on "Tend — A Habit Garden". /clinic, /clinic/slip and /dtam share the tokens and the .btn/.card classes but have not been restyled into this world. The earlier ผ้าขาวม้า weave and selvedge were removed and are not part of the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one big way to start today: a Forest pill, 76px, display-face label, button drop.

narrative.northStar: สวนเล็กๆ ที่ดูแลทุกวัน (a small garden you tend each day)
narrative.overview:
The patient opens a calm morning garden: a sage-washed page lit by a soft sun glow from the top right and a sage glow from the left, paper-white cards that float on soft layered shadows, forest-green ink, and a single clay-coloured accent word in the greeting. Progress grows rather than scores. The week is a row of tiles that fill with forest green and a check when a day is done, with a rounded bar above them that grows from sage to forest. The greeting, the date and a picture of the first posture in an arched frame make the first viewport feel personal and unhurried.

Older Thai eyes and hands set the density. Text is large and set in the looped Thai face, targets are big and pill-shaped, and each screen does one thing: one question, one posture or one outcome. Safety outranks completion, so during a posture the stop controls are pinned to the bottom of the screen, and red belongs only to stopping and 1669.

Decoration is confined to the top-right corner of the home header, beside the brand row. It is a faint sun and two leaf sprigs, never behind the greeting or any sentence.
keyCharacteristics: Sage wash ground with two fixed radial glows (sun top-right, sage left); paper-white cards on soft layered shadows.
Forest green carries the brand and every primary action; pill-shaped buttons with a soft drop shadow.
One clay accent word per heading (greeting, date, consent title); never a sentence.
One state-mark vocabulary: done = filled forest with a check, today or current = sun ring, stopped = red cross, skipped = dashed sage.
Looped Thai for everything you read; the loopless display face only at 28px and above.
Two authored motions, rise and grow-in, both collapsed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Red Is For Stopping Rule
rules.body: Stop Red appears only on stop controls, the 1669 path, the stopped-day cross, the yes answer to a red-flag question, and destructive or failed-save messages. A screen with no way to stop has no red.

rules.name: The Sun Never Speaks Rule
rules.body: Gold is never a text colour. It rings, fills and glows. Ink sits on it.

rules.name: The One Clay Word Rule
rules.body: Clay Ink colours one or two words inside a heading or the date line, at 18px semibold or larger. It never colours a sentence, a button or a state.

rules.name: The Loops For Reading Rule
rules.body: Any text a patient reads as a sentence is set in the looped face. The loopless display face is only for 28px and above.

rules.name: The No Clip Rule
rules.body: Thai stacks marks above and below the line, so text boxes never get a fixed height or `overflow: hidden`, and line-height never drops below 1.2 on Thai text.

rules.name: The One Thing Per Screen Rule
rules.body: Each screen holds one question, one posture or one outcome, with Back and Next (Back is omitted only where there is nowhere to go back to). The question itself is the h1; the counter lives in the header, not above the question.

rules.name: The Stop Bar Rule
rules.body: During a posture the stop controls are fixed at the bottom of the viewport: two buttons, or three when the posture is standing (ปวดแปล๊บ, เวียนหัว, เซ).

rules.name: The Corner Garden Rule
rules.body: Decoration lives only in the top-right corner of the home header, masked to fade toward the text, and never sits behind the greeting, the date or any sentence.

rules.name: The Paper On Sage Rule
rules.body: Anything that holds content is Paper with the paper lift and a 1px Hedge Line border. Anything you press to act carries the button drop. Nothing else casts a shadow.

dos: Do set patient body text at 20px in the looped face, with 1.7 line height.
Do make primary buttons 64–76px, every other target at least 56px, and the 1669 button at least 72px, with 12px between targets.
Do mark state with the one vocabulary: filled forest with a check for done, a sun ring for today or current, a red cross for stopped (never counted), a dashed sage thread for skipped.
Do put content on Paper cards with the paper lift and a 1px Hedge Line border.
Do keep decoration in the top-right corner of the home header, faded toward the text.
Do pair every lucide outline icon (stroke 2–2.5) with a Thai text label.
Do give every question and every posture step a listen button in Pine.
Do keep the stop bar fixed at the bottom for the whole posture.
Do keep DTAM credit, the "ดูต้นฉบับ" link and the AI-voice label under every posture.
donts: Don't put decoration, glows or art behind the greeting, the date or any body text.
Don't use Stop Red for anything except stopping, 1669, the stopped-day cross, the yes answer to a red-flag question, and destructive or failed-save messages.
Don't set text in gold, or set a whole sentence in Clay Ink.
Don't show progress as streaks, percentages, badges or points; the week card's count and growing bar are the only progress display.
Don't use the loopless display face below 28px.
Don't animate the 1669 button, and don't add motion beyond rise and grow-in.
